rules.rule: Flag a change that drops, duplicates, or reverses the configured placement of the V1 provider base prompt, or makes missing session/provider information fail closed when the documented behavior is fail-open. Identify a concrete model, setting, or unavailable-session case.

Flag changes that desynchronize generated provider-prompt fixtures, the mapping that selects them, the upstream sync script, or the build's dist/prompt assets. Do not propose manual edits to generated upstream snapshots without a deliberate fixture update.
